title: Research: prove sharp P104 Newton entrance at every payload depth
body:
## Summary

```diff
 PR2586 unchanged word, sharp independent Newton entrance
- fixed nine-bit payload, PR3406
+ every positive depth lambda, arbitrary arrays in B_(9 lambda)
+ same sharp source exponents: 104 Y x4, 78 N x2, 176 others x0
```

Prove the payload lift with native maps tensor-powered and scalar ADD coefficients unchanged. Full Newton-module inputs may be nonseparable across blocks. Exact stagewise execution, chart-aware dirty restoration and eight zero erasures follow from the written all-depth proof and source scalar certificate. Native covariance is inherited explicitly from PR3416, whose proof is retained unchanged alongside PR3406's.

Also give a boundary counterexample: separate block-slice Newton membership does not suffice. `pi*x_0*x_9` passes both slice tests but two block butterflies produce `(1-i)/2`.

Only `research/p104-tensor-newton/` is added. Canonical base is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`; final head is `97e20b899db9e1ba9cfc8d3010ada1c75236ec1a`. [Canonical scoped investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19009655).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3406 explicitly leaves tensor-depth extensions unrun. **After:** a written universal tensor/module argument plus a separately reconstructed 5,398-event scalar certificate and 182 reverse witness checks establish the same sharp exponents at every positive depth. All 1,245 native classes, 2,070 occurrences and 2,490 wrapper schemas are rebound to source bytes.
- The actual events 2031/2033 execute on all 262,144 coordinates of a nonseparable B_18 fixture. Forward, return and reordered forward perform 5,505,024 exact signed-floor/matrix pair comparisons. Every returned coordinate matches; reordered block stages give the identical forward array.
- Registered normal/optimized Python 3.12 replay, seven behavioral groups, scoped Ruff, committed-byte/source-history checks and the exact committed Git-free export pass. Real optimized CLI source, missing-input and Boolean receipt mutants reject. The exported payload, modes and inodes remain unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-tensor-newton
```

PROOF.md, RECEIPT.json and SOURCES.json contain the proof, complete receipt and exact source lineage. Credit Clear1nsight/PR3382 and PR3423, ywz65/PR2586, Tekalign, Ross Richardson, Arham Tahir, Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales, Jose Manuel and the retained native/geometry/compiler/precision lineage. Apache-2.0.

This is a restricted-domain all-depth theorem. The numerical fixture is one depth-two native round trip, not a full depth-two word execution. Actual input admission, intertwiners, finite numerical widths, physical ownership/routing, fast recursive realization and a favorable complete bill remain open. The unchanged-profile stop is retained. No supplier, new kappa, selected-frontier change or independent human/formal proof-kernel review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

An isolated successor package with inherited mathematical dependencies and explicit quantifiers. Source archives and selected construction are unchanged.
